```{r setup, include=FALSE}
## ---- setup ----

## Ensure knitr evaluates relative paths from the project root,
## not from manuscript/ (where this .Rmd lives).
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = here::here())

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo       = FALSE,
  warning    = FALSE,
  message    = FALSE,
  fig.align  = "center",
  fig.pos    = "H",
  out.width  = "100%",
  dpi        = 300
)

## ---- Load pipeline artifacts ------------------------------------------------
## NOTE: This file is designed to be rendered by 00_run_all.R.
##       At render time, the pipeline has already run 01--04 and all artifacts
##       exist. If rendering standalone, ensure 00_run_all.R has completed.

## Ensure working directory is project root before sourcing setup
setwd(here::here())

source(here::here("R/00_setup.R"))

dat <- readRDS(path_derived(artifacts$clean_rds))
fit <- readRDS(path_ckpt(artifacts$models_rds))

## ---- LaTeX table objects (built by 04_figures_tables.R) ---------------------
library(kableExtra)
tables_tex <- readRDS(path_ckpt("tables_tex.rds"))

## ---- Formatting helpers (mirror 00_setup.R, available for inline R) ---------
## fmt_num() and fmt_p() are already loaded via 00_setup.R
```
